_readme: Review page named actions as saved in Klai Studio (Oct 16, 2026). submitOrder = 1) review-submitOrder.js builds model.orderPayload, 2) review-buildPrintPdfs.js adds print_pdf_file_name + print_pdf_base64 to every item (one print PDF per ordered card), 3) runUtilityHook sends it, 4) confirms or shows submitError / pdfError. FileMaker reads $$BF_Model.orderPayload in 'BF - onUtility - review' (type submit); it may set orderId or submitError. Draft FM script: fm-onUtility-review-submit.md.
